spectators.label: Warrior monk in saffron
spectators.look: muscular young monk with a freshly shaved head, thick dark brows and a serious face, wearing a saffron-orange robe draped over one shoulder, a long brown wooden prayer-bead necklace and grey cloth leg wraps with straw sandals
spectators.idle: palms pressed together in a respectful bow toward the ring
spectators.shocked: beads flying off a snapped string, eyes wide

spectators.label: Elderly temple abbot
spectators.look: tiny ancient abbot with a bald wrinkled head and long white eyebrows drooping past his cheeks, a kindly smile, wearing a deep-maroon robe under a gold-trimmed patchwork stole and holding a gnarled wooden staff topped with brass rings
spectators.idle: leaning on his ringed staff, eyes closed serenely
spectators.cheer: rattling the ringed staff above his head, laughing
spectators.shocked: eyebrows blown upward revealing tiny wide eyes

spectators.label: Little novice monk
spectators.look: chubby little novice boy with a shaved round head and pink cheeks, wearing an oversized plain grey robe with sleeves too long and tiny straw sandals, holding a rice ball
spectators.idle: nibbling the rice ball, eyes glued to the ring
spectators.cheer: rice ball held up high, hopping
spectators.shocked: rice ball dropping from his hand, mouth a big round O

spectators.label: Shrine priest in a tall black cap
spectators.look: dignified slim man with neat black hair under a tall black lacquered court cap, a calm narrow face, wearing a white wide-sleeved priest robe over pale-purple hakama trousers and holding a wooden purification wand with white zigzag paper streamers
spectators.idle: wand held formally upright in both hands
spectators.cheer: waving the wand overhead, paper streamers flying
spectators.shocked: tall cap tipping backward, mouth open

spectators.label: Shrine maiden with a bell staff
spectators.look: graceful young woman with long straight black hair tied low with a white paper ribbon and calm dark eyes, wearing a white wide-sleeved shrine top and bright red pleated hakama, holding a short staff hung with golden bells
spectators.idle: bell staff held close to her chest, polite smile
spectators.cheer: jingling the golden bells high overhead
spectators.shocked: free hand covering her mouth, eyes wide

spectators.label: Mountain ascetic with a conch
spectators.look: rugged mountain ascetic with wild shoulder-length black hair, a thick beard and a tiny black pillbox cap on his forehead, wearing a checkered white-and-tan robe with big white pompom tassels on a sash, carrying a cream conch-shell trumpet
spectators.idle: conch held at his hip, stern gaze on the ring
spectators.cheer: blowing the conch with cheeks puffed, free arm out to the side
spectators.shocked: conch slipping from his hands, eyes popping

spectators.label: Prayer-wheel monk
spectators.look: round-faced cheerful monk with very short black hair and rosy cheeks, wearing layered maroon robes with a mustard-yellow sleeveless vest, spinning a small golden hand-held prayer wheel on a wooden handle
spectators.idle: spinning the prayer wheel slowly, smiling
spectators.shocked: prayer wheel frozen mid-spin, mouth a round O

spectators.label: Basket-hat flute monk
spectators.look: mysterious wandering monk whose whole head is hidden under a large upside-down woven straw basket hat, wearing a slate-blue robe with a brown patchwork stole and white leg wraps, holding a long bamboo flute
spectators.idle: flute held downward in both hands, basket hat tilted toward the ring
spectators.cheer: flute raised high like a sword
spectators.shocked: basket hat jolted up to reveal only a startled chin

spectators.label: Daoist priest with a fly whisk
spectators.look: thin elderly-looking priest with grey hair in a topknot pinned with a wooden pin and a long wispy grey beard, wearing a mustard-yellow robe with black trim and a small black-and-white yin-yang circle on the chest, a white horsetail fly whisk draped over one arm
spectators.idle: stroking his beard, fly whisk resting over his forearm
spectators.cheer: fly whisk swung overhead, beard flapping
spectators.shocked: beard standing straight out, whisk dropping

spectators.label: Giant guardian monk
spectators.look: towering muscular monk with a shaved head, a thick black beard and fierce temple-guardian brows, wearing a dark-grey robe tied up with a red sash, a huge necklace of fist-sized wooden beads, and carrying a log-shaped wooden temple-bell striker
spectators.idle: arms folded, glaring like a guardian statue
spectators.cheer: arms out wide to the sides, bellowing
spectators.shocked: giant beads swinging, eyes popped wide
